name: geo-diagnose
title: GEO SEO Hub Diagnose
job_to_be_done: Diagnose a brand, website, or page for evidence-backed GEO gaps and opportunities from user-supplied URLs, HTML, or evidence. Use for brand diagnosis, website or page audits, GEO gap analysis, and 品牌诊断、网站诊断、页面诊断. Excludes live AI-platform recall, ranking, and citation-share measurement.

trigger_surface.description: Diagnose a brand, website, or page for evidence-backed GEO gaps and opportunities from user-supplied URLs, HTML, or evidence. Use for brand diagnosis, website or page audits, GEO gap analysis, and 品牌诊断、网站诊断、页面诊断. Excludes live AI-platform recall, ranking, and citation-share measurement.
edge_cases: Run query research for customer questions

steps: Read `references/diagnosis-method.md`; read `references/audit-catalog.md` for non-legacy audit execution.
Run `python3 scripts/run_diagnose.py --input <brief.json> --output <runs-root> --execution-mode <legacy|deterministic|research|provider>`. Legacy remains the compatibility default.
Inspect `quality-report.json`, `run-lineage.json`, `source_status`, audit components, and limitations before using findings.
Deliver the complete Artifact Bus run directory.
